instructions.primary_message: This recipe makes about 16 cups of butter chicken or 8 (2-cup) servings.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and very tender, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (3 inch) piece ginger root
12 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and medium dice. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
When the onion is golden brown, add ginger and garlic to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occsaionally, until garlic is golden, 6-7 minutes more. (Reserve small bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place sugar and spices in the reserved small bowl, stir to combine, then set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp granulated sugar
2 tbsp garam masala
2 tbsp cumin, ground
4 tsp coriander
1 tbsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
1 tsp turmeric, ground
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp cardamom, ground
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the garlic is golden, add passata to the pot and stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until passata is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Add spice mix to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until spices are fragrant, 4-5 minutes more.
Add yogurt to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Add chicken to the pot, stir to combine, and cover with a lid. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is just cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the cilantro. Using a clean cutting board, shave leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the chicken is done, add cream and additional butter to the pot, then stir to combine the curry. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors have blended, 5-7 minutes more. Remove from heat, add cilantro, and stir to combine. Set aside to cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups heavy whipping cream
⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Once the butter chicken has cooled to room temperature, divide between containers.

STORING: Cover each container with an air-tight lid (or wrap tightly with plastic wrap). Place in the freezer for up to 3 months. HEATING: For best results, thaw butter chicken in the fridge overnight. Warm in a saucepan set over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 6-8 minutes. Serve over rice, with naan, a dollop of yogurt, or more fresh cilantro, if desired. Enjoy!
